rv.q: All six cast members delighted the large contingent of toddlers at the Lortel, but somehow Owen’s rubber-faced, space-gobbling, anarchic clowning felt like its own lesson.
Del Aguila and Alexander’s clever and well-delivered songs advance these objectives.

cn.t: This lively adaptation of Dav Pilkey's graphic novels charms with wacky songs, clever puppetry, and cheeky humor that delights young audiences while sneaking in timely lessons.
